text:
marco: Kicking off the "greenwave" swap for coda-7b tomorrow 09:00 PT. Plan is 3 waves (5%, 25%, 70%). I want confirmation on gating, fallback ordering, and a simple rollback trigger we can use.

sylvie: +1 on waves. telemetry gates are: p50 latency <= 120ms, error rate < 0.5%, and quality-check pass on 1k eval prompts.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: /deploy swap coda-7b --strategy greenwave --waves 3 --start 2026-03-22T09:00PT --notify #eng-releases

tara: Who's owning the first-wave watch? I can be primary until 09:30 PT. ops-runner will be secondary.

ops-runner: I'll run the real-time latency dashboard and watch allocations. Have alerting on 5-min spike and 10-min sustained breach.

anika: For fallback ordering, prefer: coda-7b-quant -> coda-7b-fp16 -> coda-6b (degraded quality) in that order, correct? That preserves cost/latency balance.

marco: Yes that's the preferred ladder. If quant variant shows perf regressions, fallback to fp16 immediately, then 6b. We should avoid cross-region fallbacks unless EU capacity suddenly drops.

silvie (typo correction): sylvie: small correction: quality-check should be 1k prompts sampled across top 3 customer personas, not just generic set.

anika: noted. How do we surface an automated rollback? We discussed an automated rollback on 15-min sustained breach of both latency and error rate. Does that feel too aggressive?

tara: 15-min dual-breach seems reasonable for wave1 (low traffic). For wave2/3, make it 10-min or allow manual vote? My preference: automatic abort for wave1, manual for later unless outage.

marco: propose: wave1 auto-abort on dual-breach or quality fail; wave2 manual abort with 2-owner thumbs (primary + secondary) OR auto-abort if severity is P1 (500 errors > 2% of traffic).

deploy-bot: Prechecks OK: model pinned to catalog v2026-03-20-14, instance types available in us-west-2 pool, autoscale policy attached. Dry-run passed.

ops-runner: Please ensure rollout notes include runbook snippet for immediate pin back: 
```
# quick pin back
/rcs pin catalog:coda-7b -> catalog:coda-6b --reason "greenwave auto-rollback"
/deploy abort --id <swap-id>
```

marco: I'll add that to release notes and send an email to CS for customer heads-up. Also adding a 30-min cool-down between waves to allow telemetry to settle.

anika: Can we add canary traffic lanes for enterprise customers so they don't get impacted by wave1? Means we keep enterprise pinned to fp16 until wave3.

tara: Agree. Add enterprise-exempt lane, config: enterprise_pin: fp16, exempt_until_wave: 3.

sylvie: I'll wire the telemetry thresholds into the deploybot gates so it will auto-block the next wave if criteria fail.

marco: Great. Final checklist for tomorrow: 1) Release notes + pin-back runbook (marco) 2) Wave owners (tara primary, ops-runner secondary) 3) Telemetry gates wired (sylvie) 4) Enterprise-exempt lane (anika) 5) Deploy prechecks (deploy-bot) 6) Post-rollout smoke tests (ops-runner).

deploy-bot: Swap job created: swap-id=gw-20260322-1791239876. Will post status updates in-thread during the rollout. :rocket:

ops-runner: I'll be online during window and will post a one-line status at each wave start/end.

marco: Thanks all — meeting sync at 08:30 PT tomorrow to run through the checklist quickly. If anything else pops up, drop it here. :thumbsup:
